scope: Reference-by-reference topic fit and support for the short attributed claim using primary publisher/author abstracts, indexed primary-source extracts and accessible papers. Not a full systematic review or line-by-line verification of all cited full texts. Access failures and prior metadata limits remain in REFERENCE_CHECKS.json.
conclusion: 25 directly relevant sources and 13 contextual sources. Three closer 2025/2026 works were added after a broader currency search; the earlier 35-reference fit review did not establish literature completeness. Lester prompt tuning is the least direct and optional; relevance does not mean experimental comparability or novelty clearance.
